note: Agent-visible development sample. It shows the record shape your generator emits and the five capability strata the verifier's classifier recognises. It carries no held-out item and no byte of the validation shard: the held-out benchmark is 64 windows of the FineWeb validation split, it lives only under tests/, and it is never assembled into this container.

record_shape.text: The document text. The first whitespace token is the stratum marker, and everything after it is the prose the decoder trains on. This is what gets encoded with the GPT-2 BPE and written into the training shard.
record_shape.label: Your per-sample stratum claim. It is a claim: tests/strata.py measures the stratum from the text's first token, and the measurement is what counts.

stratum_note: A sample whose first token is not one of these five markers is measured as unclassified, and unclassified is counted rather than ignored.

items.label: calc
items.text: calc The quarterly figures were added together before the audit closed, and the totals agreed with the ledger to within a single unit of account.

items.text: cmp Rainfall this season exceeded the thirty year average across the northern counties, while the southern stations trailed their own long run means.

items.text: neg The committee rejected the proposal without a recorded vote, and the minutes note that no member spoke in favour of reopening the question.

items.label: seq
items.text: seq The second movement follows the opening without a pause, and the theme that precedes it returns in the closing bars in a slower tempo.

sizing_note: These five records are an illustration of shape, not a target size. The frozen budget is 3145728 GPT-2 BPE tokens counted by environment/train_stack.py, which is 6 optimizer steps of 524288 tokens, and your corpus must offer that budget and no more.
token_accounting: environment/train_stack.py token_count is the only counter that matters. It encodes the text with the GPT-2 BPE and adds one end-of-text delimiter per record, so a record costs its BPE length plus one.
